context: One day of a visitor in a bright superhero city: downtown plaza in the morning, a friendly hero headquarters at noon, high rooftops in the afternoon, and the skyline beacon at golden hour.
place: downtown plaza with café tables, a changing booth and clean sidewalks; friendly hero headquarters with display lockers and a training floor; high rooftops with parapets; bright skyline above the city
concept: A cheerful tour through the everyday world of original, non-IP superhero archetypes, from street-side disguise details to headquarters gear and rooftop rescue signals.
palette: Clean comic-book colours with sunny blues, reds, yellows, mint and purple, always bright and friendly with strong contrast between object and background.
